DasMediaHub.changelog:
• Fixed crashes and ensuring reliable media playback on the latest Android devices.
• Library Enhancements: Added real-time playback indicators and animated audio visualizers to your downloaded media list.
• Fix for YouTube Search: Squashed a crash that occurred when certain YouTube search results couldn't be parsed correctly.
• Detailed Media Info: New 'Media Details' dialog featuring high-resolution thumbnails, precise file locations, and last modified timestamps.
• Singleton Player Architecture: Faster transitions between streaming and background play with our new unified player management.
• Snappier UI: Refactored image loading to be fully asynchronous, preventing stutters while browsing your library.
• Bug Fixes: General reliability improvements to the download engine and metadata extraction.
